Stripe is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Core Payments Infrastructure team.

Role Overview:
You will design, build, and operate distributed financial systems processing billions in transaction volume.

Core Requirements:
- 4+ years of professional backend engineering experience with Python and FastAPI.
- Deep expertise in PostgreSQL database modeling, indexing, and query optimization.
- Hands-on experience containerizing services with Docker and deploying to AWS.
- Demonstrated track record architecting reliable REST APIs and microservices.
- Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Kubernetes cluster orchestration and Terraform infrastructure as code.
- Knowledge of payment processing gateways, Kafka message queues, or Redis caching.
